comportamentos: Year combo on enrollment hold edit screens offers many more past years than the current 5: present (via a new helper, only for the enrollment hold form column)
Default CustomVariable.year_semester_range changed from 5 to 20 past years, so every screen and test relying on it gets the wider range: missing
An existing hold whose year is outside the range still shows its year in the combo: present in the helper
justificativa: The candidate does not change the default range in CustomVariable as the official fix does; instead it adds a generic year_form_column helper that may not be used on every hold-editing screen and may unintentionally affect other models' year columns, so the observable behavior differs from the official fix.
